meta.headline: A clearing layer for the number that settles the barrel.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: One number settles the barrel. Only one party can compute it.

points.body: Allocation, lifting and valuation are computed inside its own systems. Everyone else takes the result on trust.
From statements, weeks later, with no access to source records. Disputes surface at audit, not at close.
Regulators and auditors sample after the period is shut. The exposure has been open for months.

problem.bottom: Entitlements disputed period by period, restatements, an audit trail assembled from email.

solution.title: The solution
solution.lead: A clearing layer for the entitlement number: computed once, checkable by every counterparty.

points.body: Read-only into meters, allocation systems and operator ERPs. Nothing replaced, nothing re-keyed.
Recomputes allocation, lifting and valuation under the terms already signed.
Stamps a tamper-evident record. Every party checks the same result at close.

solution.bottom: The reconciliation cycle. Maps to ISAE 3000. Priced per asset, inside the perimeter.

points.title: Custody, not capability
points.body: Every party holds the data. None holds a record the others accept without redoing the work. That gap does not close from inside one operator.

points.title: Written from the operator's seat
points.body: Forty years of fiscal practice encoded as deterministic controls. Controls decide; the advisory layer never sits in the verification path.

points.title: No incumbent passes all three
points.body: Continuous, cross-party and audit-defensible at once. Continuous means every period, not a sampled look-back.
